p.strong: What can go wrong, and what stops it

div.p: Restore failed, then a save runs → no sentinel, the save is refused.
Two containers on one prefix → the second is refused by the lease.
A sync deletes the wrong thing → the old object is in .persist-trash/.
The home directory collapses → the shrink guard pauses saving.
It grows without bound → the quota pauses saving.
SIGKILL, no grace period → at most one interval is lost.
